observations.the_ides_of_milk: Nine quest stages. Cassius completes the quest and Gillie separately grants the lamp and amulet. Cowbell travel uses one air rune per modeled trip and lands at [3259, 3277, 0].
observations.a_ruff_situation: The two sewing routes use a normal needle and thread or the separately claimed Costume needle. The modeled fur is bear fur.
observations.the_ribbiting_tale_of_a_lily_pad_labour_: The public savannah path and fairy ring AJP approach connect the oasis. The reward opens the local hardwood patch.
observations.at_first_light: Two jerboa tails can be carried in or caught with Imia's box trap. The local route includes needle and hammer pickups. Two catches give 274 Hunter XP separately from the completion reward.
observations.vale_totems: The tutorial consumes an oak log and four unstrung oak shortbows. These are one valid decoration and log combination.
observations.ethically_acquired_antiquities: The Fortis and Varrock museum interactions are distinct. Fortis Cothon charters connect to Port Sarim. The free mainland travel path remains available.
observations.meat_and_greet: The wolf den and minotaur are distinct encounters. Two test kebabs cover the sample and the arena fight.
observations.death_on_the_isle: Aldarin is reachable via the 20-coin Sunset Coast ferry, charters, the existing quetzal network and fairy ring CKQ. The Costumer gives the needle after the quest.
